summary: Native Blender/Maya agent control and material exchange, automatically exposed through the bundled Clash MCP.
architecture_notes: User-authorized exception: native DCC adapters and their shared transport are Python; packaging and tests are TypeScript.
No new Asset Host routes, storage authority or sync workflow. Native control is a session-authenticated loopback connection behind the existing Clash MCP, not a separately configured MCP server.
The selected working folder resolves project identity through normal CLI discovery. No status preflight, cloud credentials, or marker edits.
Transfers run in a CLI subprocess polled on native UI timers. No background Python thread touches either DCC API.
Receive copies the authorized CLI projection into a fresh working-tree file. Never load mutable DCC resources directly from an immutable Asset cache link.
Unchanged source path and bytes derive a stable import id for retry. Host remains the authority for supported formats and immutable publication.

Scene/object inspection, viewport capture and native Python execution provide the core Blender-MCP-style controls. This is not a vendored copy of a third-party Blender MCP and does not claim its external asset-provider integrations.
Connection credentials live only in machine-private ~/.clash/dcc-connections; they are never project markers, cloud admission, public Asset data, or agent arguments.

Native commands execute on the UI thread. Responses are session-scoped and replay-safe; expired response bodies cause an unknown-result error rather than reexecution. A timeout never authorizes automatic mutation retry.

key_files.shared/bridge.py: Public CLI transport, asynchronous Jobs, snapshot uploads, and independent receive copies.
key_files.shared/control.py: Bounded, session-authenticated, nonblocking loopback server polled by native UI timers.
key_files.shared/native.py: Native Python execution with bounded captured output and explicit partial-failure guidance.
key_files.shared/maya_tools.py: Discovers pinned MayaMCP native scripts and derives/validates tool contracts without a second MCP server.
key_files.maya/clash_assets_maya/mayatools/UPSTREA: Vendored MIT source revision, excluded broken generator, and local fixes.
key_files.blender/clash_assets/__init__.py: Native Sidebar UI, image/GLB import, selected-object GLB export.
key_files.maya/clash_assets_maya/__init__.py: PySide6/PySide2 material browser and file-texture import.

verification: Native Blender/Maya smoke checks in README.md are required before claiming host compatibility is verified.
